blurb: The Carl Dickman Par 3 Golf Course offers a fun and relaxing round of golf with a short and sporty layout. It is located a few hundred yards from Long Island Sound off South Pine Creek and Old Dam Roads in Fairfield. The course is well kept and managed, suitable for both low and high handicappers.
